procedural_matters: POL was represented by Hanna Rogowska.
ISR was represented by Gaya Datiashivli .
DEN Astrid Elnegaard attended as a witness for POL.
Eran Sela (ISR Coach) attended the hearing as an observer.
PUR Marina Negrom attended as a witness for ISR.
Jury was constituted in accordance with N1.4(b)
facts: Wind 10-12 knots. Small waves, quite flat sea.
In race 6 POL was sailing on starboard tack slightly above the starboard layline approaching Mark 1 for the second time.
ISR was sailing on port tack also approaching Mark 1.
The boats were on a collision course.
When half a boat length from the mark ISR luffed and passed head to wind.
Before ISR reached a close-hauled course, POL luffed eight degrees.
POL did not sail above a close-hauled course.
If POL had not luffed contact would have occurred between POL's port side and ISR's starboard side.
No boat took a penalty turn.
conclusions: After passing head to wind, ISR, a tacking boat, did not keep clear of POL as required by RRS 13.
